title: pseudolysimachion spurium subsp. paniculatum
intro: Pseudolysimachion spurium subsp. paniculatum, commonly known as alpine marsh cinquefoil, is a plant species within the family Rosaceae. It is used for its medicinal properties, with reported health benefits including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects, which may aid in reducing pain and improving overall well-being. The therapeutic actions of alpine marsh cinquefoil include its ability to modulate immune responses, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
